notes.title: Angelic Community Update: Biggest Expansion Ever, Campaign Updates Inside
notes.notes: [p]The last few months have marked one of the most dramatic evolutions in Angelic’s history. We’ve revamped vast parts of the game and added a bazillion new features. These additions are altering the core systems and are crucial for the upcoming narrative campaigns, while also significantly improving our free-to-play multiplayer edition.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a detailed look into the massive overhaul currently underway:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Cinematic Layers[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve added cinematic kill cams and brutal combat moments that hit like a freight train.[/p][p]New systems include:[/p][list][*][p]Kill cams with dramatic slow motion, camera shifts, special FX, and sequencers[/p][/*][*][p]Overkill animations with dismemberment and brutal deaths[/p][/*][*][p]Environmental interactions like knockbacks, wall collisions, and terrain hazards[/p][/*][*][p]Destructible elements like bridges, barrels, and structural weak points[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="cjoGklUG6DI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Kill Cam Feature Showcase. Gameplay Capture. Viewer discretion advised![/i][/p][p][/p][p]These aren’t just visual flair, they improve readability. Thanks to our new cinematic system, even multi-target kills feel clear, satisfying, and brutal.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]MetaHuman Integration[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Since Angelic's 2020 build, we’ve been crafting cinematic experiences, but our characters always struggled to deliver the hyper-realistic facial expressions we were striving for. They usually looked solid but never quite [i]felt[/i] real enough. Until now...[/p][p][/p][p]Since mid-2023, we’ve been migrating our heroes to MetaHuman, Epic Games' cutting-edge character infrastructure for Unreal Engine. After years of intensive R&D, facial rig adjustments, custom shader tuning, and performance testing, this migration is now nearing completion.[/p][p][/p][p]MetaHuman enables the hyper-realistic facial expressions we need for our upcoming, emotion-heavy campaign.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/e7a5c7a9d8a46f882fdcad638e7bfd33a348068a.png"][/img][i]We captured countless hilarious expressions, but space is limited, so we’ll only tease a few :) (Featuring Aurora)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Now, our characters finally feel real, breathing, reacting, and emoting with film-quality fidelity.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Heroes & Characters[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Angelic universe is expanding. Here are some of the characters now implemented or in active development:[/p][p]Xue & Chun, dark and light siblings. You’ve already met them, but never had the chance to play with them. They’re not coming alone. They bring their guardian: Shanwang, the Mountain King, a dragon-horse synth. Playing as Shanwang is something else entirely. Imagine controlling a giant winged synth, hearing his poetic, deep reactions. We can't wait.[/p][p][/p][p]Bart, the Vivibot. Your favorite sarcastic bot who still can't pronounce the letter “B” properly and loves dancing... ahem, also punching enemies into the sky.[/p][p][/p][p]Diana Lindberg, an enhanced (cybernetic) human, independent journalist, and media icon. With nearly 2 billion followers, she’s both a powerful symbol and a prime target for corporate assassins.[/p][p][/p][p]Sopdet, the Oracle of the Goddess. Diplomat, warrior, and luminous daughter of Iset. You’ve seen her concept art before.[/p][p][/p][p]Matriarch of the Nameless Ones, the ancient librarian and keeper of the Wall of Arch-Lore. Whatever you do, never look into her third eye.[/p][p][/p][p]Infested horrors, including the Niataju, a swarm horror capable of spreading infestation rapidly, and Marajuaronesis, a towering, regenerative abomination. Long-time followers may remember the early female version of this creature from our 2021 vertical slice. The new one is 100 times more terrifying.[/p][p][/p][p]Supreme Cartel Commandos, brutal eugenic supersoldiers. Hoshi Ryu kenshis and vanguards are also coming, including the infamous Bōrei, undead warriors cursed to never find peace. That’s all we can say for now, to avoid spoilers.[/p][p][/p][p]Ryoji Hoshinaga, a powerful Hoshi Ryu lieutenant who will play a key role in the upcoming campaign.[/p][p]Two major new characters, whose names we can’t reveal yet due to story spoilers, only identified for now s Z. and L. One of them will appear in the attached screenshot. They’re neo-humans, but with a twist.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/4ac9692b85541184d310a538c4e715ad66cdd89d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Meet L (name hidden to avoid spoilers). A major addition to the story. What you see here is a direct in-game capture.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Many more: infested humans, rogue synths, colony NPCs, mutant creatures, and yes, even the redesign of our divine goddess Iset. She will be magnificent.[/p][p][/p][p]We told you, this is the biggest expansion in Angelic’s history.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Combat System Overhaul[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We completely rewrote how abilities work under the hood.[/p][p][/p][p]Heroes now instantly react to your commands. You click, they respond. They now clearly show what they’re about to do whenever you select an ability. For example, select Rumbrogon's cleave, and he’ll visibly raise his weapon to show he’s about to strike. Previously, they wouldn’t react until the skill was executed.[/p][p][/p][p]To make this possible, we:[/p][list][*][p]Remade and polished hundreds of animations and re-implemented them[/p][/*][*][p]Re-aligned VFX and SFX for every ability[/p][/*][*][p]Tuned transitions, hit reactions, and targeting logic[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The result? A far more responsive, predictable, and fast gameplay loop.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also adding facial expressions to every single animation. We aim for perfection, and it doesn't matter if it's combat or cinematic. Our characters must look superb. Period.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Unique Hero Mechanics[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We're doubling down on what makes each hero feel truly distinct, not just in theme but in gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Seline can now fly across the map with full vertical control, evade melee attackers, and turbo through danger[/p][/*][*][p]Odile can glide over deadly zones and move at ultra-fast speeds mid-air (though she can’t gain much vertical elevation)[/p][/*][*][p]Phoenix and Xander now feature continuous-fire mechanics, hold down LMB to dynamically aim and sustain firepower[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These mechanics introduce entirely new tactical dimensions. They required deep changes to traversal systems, camera logic, animations, passives, and even enemy AI. They also affected other abilities. For example, Seline's healing abilities have been migrated to a continuous variation, so she keeps healing while her allies are under attack. That makes our turn-based combat feel more multi-layered, sometimes almost real-time, with multiple heroes reacting simultaneously.[/p][p][/p][p]And more heroes are gaining signature mechanics. Chun can teleport enemies into cliffs, or lava pools. That means the battlefield is becoming even more interactive.[/p][p][/p][p]Pale Phantom can now enter Qatom Swarm Cloud mode. He disintegrates into millions of cubes and can pass through thin objects like a ghost or fly (kind of) and effectively become untargetable unless hit by an AoE ability.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Dynamic and Interactable Environments[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]You can now jump with your heroes. Obviously, with flying and gliding mechanics being implemented, we couldn’t leave other heroes without the basic ability of jumping.[/p][p][/p][p]But mind where you jump. Fall damage is now a thing, and heroes can weaponize it. If Chun teleports you to the edge of a cliff, falling might kill you. Or if someone destroys the bridge you’re standing on, your hero will fall, unless they can fly or glide.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hero Customizations[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We are revamping our customization and skin system. By using our customized version of Unreal's mutables, you will be able to personalize your heroes with a great degree of control. Want a different hair color for Aurora? Done. A new eye design for Chun? Sure. Change the color theme of Phoenix or swap wing designs on Seline? Go ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]Only one rule: you cannot alter the proportions or facial structures of the heroes. This preserves their identity and visual consistency, and ensures cinematics work as designed.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Physical Improvements and Procedural Animations[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We have significantly improved the ragdoll system and IK (inverse kinematics) for our characters, both heroes and NPCs. This was a much-needed upgrade to make their animations physically interactable, and their falls and deaths ultra-realistic. It will hugely complement our kill cameras too.[/p][p][/p][p]Even more, we are adding procedural animations to our heroes. Combined with their new fall, jump, hard stop, and hit animations, the procedural system makes them respond and react naturally to their environment.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]UI & UX Redesign[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re rebuilding the entire combat interface, along with the hero menu and game lobby.[/p][p][/p][p]Expect:[/p][list][*][p]Cleaner layouts[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer ability indicators[/p][/*][*][p]Faster navigation[/p][/*][*][p]More visual feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Sexier designs[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We revamped how the combat log works and overhauled nearly every UI component in the game. Not just in combat, but also in the hero menu, the game lobby ([url="https://x.com/AngelicTheGame/status/1897667341309116773"]you may have seen the video[/url]), and even the main menu. Our new menu sub-levels feature signature hero poses and beautiful 3D backgrounds.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Visual Effects Revamp[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re upgrading every visual effect in the game. Everything, from Seline’s healing pulses to Phoenix’s rifle fire, has been redesigned. Odile’s gravity powers now ripple across the terrain, Chun’s portals look epic, and Shanwang’s mountain breeze might literally freeze you in awe.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/7af47abaff815f28c17831a0786b97594a1e0451.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Shanwang and Xue. What a majestic duo! Their combat abilities are just as impressive as their stories, looks, and personalities.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Narrative Mode Preparation[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Everything listed here, from MetaHuman upgrades to new abilities, lays the foundation for the single-player campaign.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The campaign has always been our dream. Everything we’ve built so far is leading to it.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’re developing rich, handcrafted environments, stunning cinematics, and a deep, unforgettable story brought to life by our multi-layered cast of heroes.[/p][p][/p][p]So far, we’ve only talked about the systems already built or in development. This milestone also includes hero progression mechanics (with tons of new abilities) and more features.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]A Note About the Future[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Once our current sprint is over, we will begin work on hero progression. This will be just as ambitious as what we’ve already shared.[/p][p][/p][p]We are adding approximately 10 new abilities per hero, plus more modifier abilities.[/p][p][/p][p]These won’t just be new skills, but entirely new categories of abilities. At the moment you’ve only seen basic abilities (usable during active turns), stance abilities (triggered during passive turns to make heroes react to events), and a few limited passive abilities (like Rumbrogon's disengagement attack).[/p][p][/p][p]Now we are adding Alterations, which significantly transform a hero’s kit by turning them into something else. For example, Daeva can become the Succubus, Odile becomes the White Swan, Seliné turns into the Dark Nightingale, and Aurora transforms into the Daughter of the Storm. These powerful skills unlock entirely new abilities or alter existing ones in dramatic ways.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also adding ability modifiers, indirect skills that impact your basic, stance, passive, and alteration abilities.[/p][p][/p][p]On top of that, we are introducing combo abilities, tag abilities (coordinate with an ally to unleash devastating attacks), and even infection abilities. Infection will now play a much deeper and more sophisticated role, so you’ll need to monitor your heroes’ infection levels carefully. Some heroes and units are immune, like already-infested heroes (Rumbrogon, Odile) or fully mechanical units.[/p][p][/p][p]This evolution of progression will push tactical depth in Angelic to an entirely new level.[/p][p][/p][p]This milestone, known internally as the Prime Vertical Slice, and officially titled Angelic: Dark Symphony Prelude - Dread Heaven, is without question the most ambitious development phase in our history. And it’s far from over. But each step brings us closer to making Angelic the strategy-RPG experience we all envisioned.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll share more gameplay videos, visuals, official soundtracks and screenshots in the coming months. Please bear with us. These features are massive, and our full focus is on delivering them.[/p][p][/p][p]If we’ve been quiet lately, it’s not because we’ve gone dark. It’s because we’ve been building like mad. We’ve expanded the team, sharpened our focus, and poured ourselves into something we believe in.[/p][p][/p][p]So please, don’t expect frequent updates. But when we do share something, expect it to be fantastic.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for staying with us on this ride.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Glory to Angelic 🪽[/b][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update Notes - 20 August 2025
notes.notes:
Hello Angels ,

We've rolled out a new update. Below are the detailed patch notes:

[b]Game Design Adjustments[/b]

*Seliné (Micro Angels Stance): Stance now lasts for 2 turns only. Revive ability cost increased to 7 AP (previously 2 AP) and has a 4 turn cooldown (previously 3 turns).
*Daeva (Void Storm) : Void Storm attack area reduced to 1500 cm (from 2000 cm) AND radius reduced to 4000 cm (from 5000 cm).
*Xander (Mirror the Pain): Now it lasts for 2 turns with a 0 cooldown. You can trigger it for free, similar to Seliné’s Micro Angels.
*Thundershark Control Consoles : Capture costs updated: 10 Energy (previously 22) and 9 AP (previously 5).

[b]Rank Point System Updates[/b]
Level Based Adjustments
*Removed penalties for level differences.
*Point allocation adjusted based on level differences:
+1 point for winning against players 3 levels below you.
+2 points for winning against players within ±3 levels.
+3 points for winning against players 4+ levels above you.

[b]Game Duration Multipliers[/b]
*Less then 5 minutes : No points.
*Less then 10 minutes : 0.75x multiplier.
*10-20 minutes: Full points (1x multiplier).
*More then 20 minutes   :1.25x multiplier

[b]League Based Modifiers[/b]
*Winning against higher league players: 50% bonus per league difference.
*Winning against lower league players: 20% deduction per league difference.
*Losing against higher league players: Additional 1 penalty.
*Losing against lower league players: Additional 0.5 penalty per league difference.

[b]AI Difficulty Settings[/b]
*Easy: No advantages, 4hero limit. Disabled for commanders level 10+.
*Normal: AI has 1 energy console, no deploy limit. No neutral units.
*Hard: AI has 1 energy console, various neutral units. Available only for commanders level 10+.
*Brutal: AI has all advantages from Hard mode, plus an additional energy console. Available only for commanders level 10+.

[b]Experience Points Mechanics[/b]
*XP Gains
*PvP: 30 XP per win.
*PvE: 5 XP (Easy), 10 XP (Normal), 20 XP (Hard), 35 XP (Brutal).
*Consecutive Wins: +5 XP per consecutive win (PvP only).
*Losers: 2 XP per killed hero, 1 XP per killed neutral unit.
*Tutorial Completion: 100 XP (one time reward).

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
*Audio: New sounds for Tank and Big Gun explosions.
*Grenade Bug: Previously, if you clicked on a hero instead of an empty space when throwing Xander's grenade, the grenade would become useless later in the game. This issue has now been fixed, ensuring the grenade functions correctly regardless of where you click.
*UI Fixes: Improved ability to detail UI functionality.
*Stance Mechanics Clarification: We've received feedback about confusion regarding how to exit stances and manage posture abilities. A temporary solution has been added to the UI to help guide players. However, please note that this is a placeholder, and a detailed UI design for better stance and posture management will be included in the next update.
*Manipulate Gravity:Previously, running through the Manipulate Gravity area allowed players to regain all the APs lost after leaving the Manipulate Gravity zone, making the ability ineffective. This issue has been resolved now, AP will be consumed appropriately when you enter the Manipulate Gravity area, even if you attempt to leave and return.
*Camera Issues: Resolved camera focus problems near objects and raised platforms.
Steam API Integration: Steam players can now play multiplayer modes without needing an EOS account. However please note Steam and Epic Store players will no longer be seeing each other and can play against each other.
*Run to Benchmark" Functionality Previously, the "Run to Benchmark" feature automatically set graphics to Epic for all players. Now, it intelligently adjusts your graphics settings based on your PC's specifications to ensure optimal performance.

-*-

notes.title: Hotfix Update Notes (104)
notes.notes:
Hello Angels ,

We've rolled out a new update packed with several important fixes and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Below are the detailed patch notes:

[b]XP Calculations:[/b]

[b]Consecutive Win Bonus Adjustments:[/b]

AI Battles: The consecutive win bonus for victories against AI opponents has been completely removed. This change ensures that XP gains remain fair and balanced across all game modes.

PvP Battles: The consecutive win bonus for victories against real players is now capped at 10 consecutive wins. This means the maximum bonus XP you can earn through this method is 50 XP (10 wins x 5 XP each). This cap ensures that XP rewards remain consistent and fair for all players.

Tutorial XP Reward: Completing the tutorial now grants a one-time bonus of 100 XP. This reward will no longer influence gameplay time, ensuring a smoother and more accurate progression experience.

[b]Negative Ranks Recovery:[/b]
 Players with negative ranks will now need to play and finish a PvP match to restore their rank to a positive level. 

[b]Tutorial Win Impact:[/b]

Previously, the tutorial was mistakenly counted as a win without affecting gameplay time. This issue has been addressed, and now the tutorial will only provide a one-time 100 XP bonus without impacting gameplay time. This ensures that tutorial completion is accurately reflected in your overall progress and prevents gaining the bonus XP repetitively, which was not an intended action.

[b]XP Bar Display:[/b]

[b]Updated XP Bar Values:[/b]

The values displayed next to the XP bar have been updated to show "Total XP collected (from Level 0) / Total XP required for next level (from Level 0)." This change provides clearer insight into your progress toward leveling up.

[b]AI Behavior Fixes[/b]

[b]AI Xander Attack Fix:[/b]

AI Xander has been adjusted to behave more strategically during battles. After executing his regular attack, AI Xander will now correctly wait until the end of his turn before taking further action.

[b]UI & UX Improvements:[/b]

[b]Enemy Neutral Units Damage UI Color:[/b]

We have fixed the UI color issue where damage from enemy neutral units was displayed as if it were from your own ally units. This caused some confusion, which should now be resolved, making it easier to distinguish between ally and enemy actions.

[b]Camera Stuck in Tactical Mode:[/b]

A potential fix has been implemented to address the issue where the camera could get stuck in Tactical mode during the roaming phase.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[b]AI Captain Deployment Issue:[/b]

* We've fixed a bug where the AI would sometimes deploy no captain or the wrong captain. Although players were not generally aware of this issue, it has been resolved on our side to ensure proper AI behavior in matches.
* A critical localization issue preventing Cyrillic and other alphabets from appearing correctly in-game has been fixed.
* We've addressed and resolved certain crashes that occurred during the logout process, improving overall game stability.
* We have fixed the issue where, after defeating the tank, it would go underground and cause the game to crash. Players can now continue playing the game as intended without encountering this problem.
